long_biography.plain_text:
Immogra began as a small Flemish development business established by Carlos De Graeve in 1967. Dirk and his twin brother Frank joined the company roughly a generation later, broadening its work from Deinze and the Belgian coast into Ghent, Antwerp and Brussels. Their expansion turned a local family operation into a multi-company property group.

De Graeve combines executive leadership with direct control through family holding structures. The group develops offices, homes, shops and student accommodation from site acquisition through delivery, favouring durable architecture and efficient decision-making. Recent work has placed lower-energy buildings, green public space and mixed-use urban renewal at the centre of Immogra’s approach. The brothers continue as the principal controlling figures behind its investment and development platform.
